title: MoM – Weekly Standup W8 – Project Aurora – 2026-02-26
content:
Meeting: Weekly Standup W8 – Project Aurora
Date: 26 February 2026
Chair: Jane Smith
Attendees: Jane Smith (PM/OCM), Marco Rossi (R&D), Sarah Chen (Procurement), Tom Walsh (Quality), Lisa Park (Packaging)

UPDATES
- Marco Rossi: Formula stability testing in progress, on track for 05 March deadline. Early indicators positive
- Sarah Chen: Supplier contacted regarding lead times, formal response expected by 28 February
- Tom Walsh: Awaiting Marco's stability report before proceeding with compliance sign-off
- Lisa Park: Dieline update on hold pending Sarah's lead time confirmation and fill weight spec lock

SCOPE CHANGE RAISED
- Categories (David Osei) have requested fragrance variant be added back to Aurora scope, UK market only
- Impact assessment required from R&D (formulation effort) and Packaging (additional dieline and artwork)
- Jane to circulate updated project plan reflecting this scope addition by 01 March
- Scope review meeting to be scheduled with Categories and Packaging for week of 03 March

ACTIONS
- Jane Smith: Prepare G3 gate update slide for governance board by 24 February 2026 [OVERDUE AT TIME OF MEETING]
- Jane Smith: Circulate updated project plan with fragrance variant scope change by 01 March 2026

RISKS NOTED
- Fragrance variant re-addition has not been impact-assessed — risk of G4 timeline slip if scope is not locked quickly

NEXT MEETING
- Aurora Scope Review with Categories on 04 March 2026
